newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea's May import, export prices rise.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's May import, export prices rise.

text.p: South Korean import prices rose 8.9 percent in May from a year ago, while export prices gained 9.9 percent, both in won terms, the Bank of Korea said on Wednesday.
A central bank statement said import prices were based on costs, insurance and freight (CIF) and export prices were free on board (FOB).
Import prices for raw materials and capital goods in May rose 9.3 percent and 7.1 percent respectively from a year ago. Import prices for consumer goods increased 8.5 percent.
Export prices of industrial goods went up 10.4 percent, and for mining goods 14.7 percent. But export prices for fisheries, forestry and agricultural products fell by 3.7 percent, the statement said.
